summary: Binance 事件后，研究者开始讨论把限速和恢复放在资产（代币合约）里，而不只放在账户代码里，Magicians 上出现 ERC-8474、ERC-8475 两个 ERC-20 限额提案。potuz 公开质疑 MetaMask 和 Rabby 默认给接近 1 gwei 的优先费。potuz 提交 EIP-8483，为验证者登记后量子材料；EIP-8288 被提议用在 OP Stack 上压缩 PQ 签名数据。

items.topic: Binance 事件后的账户防护：账户层还是资产层
items.title: ethresear.ch：资产级的支出限额与恢复
items.note: 00:15 发布（作者 dlebee）。观点：智能钱包、ERC-7579 模块、社交恢复和 EIP-7702 委托都把策略写在账户代码里，但有两个缺口。一是已有 `transferFrom` 授权的合约可以绕过钱包的每日限额；二是在 7702 下，被盗的 EOA 私钥可以重新委托，把原来的防护策略换掉。资产级检查能覆盖所有减少余额的路径，长期甚至可以由协议对原生 ETH 做。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: asset-level spending limits and recovery
items.note_en: Posted at 00:15 by dlebee. Smart wallets, ERC-7579 modules, social recovery and EIP-7702 delegation all put policy in account code, and that leaves two gaps. First, a contract that already holds a `transferFrom` approval can bypass the wallet's daily limit. Second, under 7702 a stolen EOA key can re-delegate and replace the original protection. Asset-level checks cover every path that reduces a balance, and in the long run the protocol could even apply them to native ETH.
items.topic_en: Account protection after Binance: the account layer or the asset layer

items.topic: 交易费：钱包默认小费过高
items.title: potuz：质疑 MetaMask 和 Rabby 默认优先费
items.note: 05:23 发帖：钱包默认给接近 1 gwei 的优先费，而按 wei 级别给小费就够；扩容让上链更便宜，结果一半费用是小费，扩容就白做了。
items.title_en: potuz questions MetaMask and Rabby default priority fees
items.note_en: 05:23: wallets default to a priority fee close to 1 gwei when a tip measured in wei would do. Scaling makes transactions cheaper, but if half the fee is the tip, the scaling work is wasted.

items.topic: 后量子：验证者 PQ 材料登记与 L2 签名聚合
items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8288 在 OP Stack 上扩展信任
items.note: 09:05 发布。如果每个 L2 用户都换成 PQ 签名，签名会占交易数据的 99%，6 个 blob 能装的转账从约 6,600 笔降到约 155 笔。采用 EIP-8288（内存池签名与证明聚合）后，签名移出交易，由 leanVM 聚合证明统一上链，用 leanSPHINCS 签名的交易可压到 100 到 129 字节。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: scaling the trust with EIP-8288 on OP Stack
items.note_en: Posted at 09:05. If every L2 user switched to PQ signatures, signatures would take 99% of transaction data and the transfers that fit in 6 blobs would fall from about 6,600 to about 155. With EIP-8288 (mempool signature and proof aggregation), signatures move out of the transaction and a single leanVM aggregate proof goes onchain, bringing a transaction signed with leanSPHINCS down to 100 to 129 bytes.
items.topic_en: Post-quantum: validator PQ material registration and L2 signature aggregation

summary_en: After the Binance incident, researchers began asking whether rate limits and recovery should live in the asset (the token contract) rather than only in account code, and two ERC-20 limit proposals, ERC-8474 and ERC-8475, appeared on Magicians. potuz publicly questioned MetaMask and Rabby for defaulting to a priority fee close to 1 gwei. potuz also submitted EIP-8483 so validators can register post-quantum material, and EIP-8288 was proposed for compressing PQ signature data on the OP Stack.
